reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Instagram.

My personal account, which I have used for years to share my life, photos and original content, became inaccessible after an account deactivation issue. Since October, I have been trying everything possible to recover it.

The situation has become incredibly frustrating. I cannot access my account, the recovery process repeatedly displays errors, and I am unable to submit an appeal properly.

I have contacted Meta Support multiple times, but I keep receiving automated responses. I have even tried reaching support through Facebook, only to be told that human support cannot help with disabled accounts.

My account has now been flagged under an authenticity policy, despite being my genuine personal account, with my own identity and photographs.

What is particularly disappointing is the complete lack of transparency and the absence of meaningful customer support. Users deserve an opportunity to explain their situation and have their cases properly reviewed by a real person.

Instagram should not be able to disable someone’s account while providing no effective way to appeal or obtain assistance.

I hope Meta takes these issues seriously and improves its account recovery and customer support systems. No user should have to go through this experience.

reviews.title: Perdeu a essência
reviews.text:
O Instagram perdeu muito da sua essência: a de ser uma rede social voltada ao relacionamento entre amigos.

A plataforma passou a priorizar cada vez mais conteúdos recomendados por algoritmos, vídeos, Reels, páginas e publicações de pessoas desconhecidas, deixando em segundo plano aquilo que deveria ser uma das suas principais funções: conectar amigos.

Falta uma opção simples e permanente: uma aba exclusiva para amizades, onde apareçam somente as publicações das pessoas adicionadas, como fotos, momentos, novidades e atualizações.

Quem quiser consumir vídeos, conteúdos virais e recomendações pode utilizar as abas específicas para isso. Mas deveria existir a liberdade de escolher um feed verdadeiramente social, sem interferência constante de recomendações.

As redes sociais estão perdendo sua identidade. O Instagram já foi uma plataforma essencialmente de fotografias, e o Facebook era um espaço de compartilhamento, diversão e relacionamento.

Hoje, parece que tudo gira em torno de engajamento, visualizações, seguidores e monetização.

Talvez esteja na hora de surgir uma nova rede social que resgate a simplicidade do antigo Orkut: um ambiente voltado exclusivamente para amizades, fotos, conversas e interação entre pessoas.

O Instagram precisa entender que nem todo mundo quer ser influenciador, criador de conteúdo ou consumidor de vídeos. Muitas pessoas simplesmente querem manter contato com seus amigos.

reviews.text:
I'd like to suggest adding customizable Story audience lists and fixing in-app glitches.

When trying to restore an accidentally deleted story from "Recently Deleted" within the 24-hour window, the app repeatedly fails with a "Network Error: Your video wasn't restored" message—even on strong Wi-Fi and cellular data, and after logging out and reinstalling. Because the story used the weekly Spotlight feature, deleting it also wasted the weekly Spotlight allowance with no way to recover the post. Please fix the server sync bug on Recently Deleted stories.


Currently, Instagram offers Close Friends or the option to hide Stories from individual accounts. However, there is no practical way to create multiple custom audiences.

It would be extremely useful to allow users to create and name their own audience lists (for example: friends, acquaintances, professional contacts etc) and share Stories with those audiences without displaying a special indicator that reveals they're on a particular list.

Close Friends feels limited. Sometimes users simply want more control over who sees specific content without making the audience selection obvious such as the green circle indicator. 

The hide story from option isn’t ideal when you have to manually select each person and you have hundreds to over one thousand followers.

Please consider adding discreet, customizable private audience lists. This would give users significantly more flexibility and control over their privacy.

Mittlerweile habe ich STUNDEN meiner privaten Zeit damit verschwendet, wieder Zugriff auf mein eigenes Konto zu bekommen. Und das völlig unnötig!

Wenn Instagram tatsächlich einen möglichen Hackerangriff festgestellt hat, hätte man mich zunächst vernünftig informieren und mir beispielsweise empfehlen können, mein Passwort zu ändern oder zusätzliche Sicherheitsmaßnahmen einzurichten. Mein Passwort war bereits äußerst komplex und alles andere als leicht zu erraten.
